description: One page of a wallet's wallet-to-wallet transfers of SOL and tokens, newest first (REST history, 7 days). `direction`: 'in' = received, 'out' = sent; omit for both. `wallet` in each row is always the queried wallet; `transfer.from` / `transfer.to` are the two wallets. SOL appears as the wrapped-SOL mint (So111…112). `transfer.symbol` is null until resolved (key on mint). Swaps are not transfers (use list_wallet_trades). No source filter. `minVolumeUsd` / `maxVolumeUsd` bound the USD size (unpriced rows are then excluded). To page, pass `cursor` = previous `next`; stop when `next` is null.

cursor.description: Pass the previous response's `next` for the next page

from.description: Unix ms or ISO-8601 start bound

limit.description: Rows per page; default 20 to conserve context — raise only if needed

mints.description: Tokens to keep (wrapped SOL included), up to 100

to.description: Unix ms or ISO-8601 end bound

name: list_wallet_transfers
